current_p0_2_source_hardening.role: risk-of-bias/source-independence hardening plus SOGI representativeness audit
current_p0_2_source_hardening.sogi_core_finding: Inclusive SOGI measurement exists in adjacent AI-use/mental-health and targeted LGBTQ+ intervention research, but hardened direct AI-dependence psychometrics remain dominated by binary male/female reporting and lack demonstrated TGD/nonbinary/orientation-specific measurement invariance.

canonical_factorization: LIFE_STAGE x SOCIAL_ROLE x ROSTER_PHASE x HOUSEHOLD_CONTEXT x RELATIONSHIP_CONTEXT x BELIEF_ECOLOGY x DEPENDENCY_CARD x PSYCHOSOCIAL_STATE x INTEREST_CUE x DIGITAL_ECOLOGY x AI_MODE x AI_FEATURES x ACCESS_MODEL x EXPOSURE_INTENSITY; SOGI remains a parallel representation/fairness/heterogeneity layer, not an identity risk multiplier.
topa_survivors_after_p0_2: Nicotine has direct meta-analytic therapeutic conversational-agent evidence, but no general/companion LLM nicotine coefficient is admitted.
Gambling has direct chatbot-CBT RCT evidence, but the evidence base is tiny and comparative effects are often null or mixed.
Problematic smartphone use has direct cross-sectional association with AI-chatbot dependence; causality remains open.
Healthy Minds studies provide direct LGBQ+ and nonbinary/other-gender AI-use representation signals, not dependence coefficients.

An LGBTQ+ social-robot RCT demonstrates that aggregate intervention effects can differ by cisgender versus TGD status, proving the need for heterogeneity and measurement-validity checks without transporting its effect to LLM dependence.
No hardened direct AI-dependence measurement-invariance evidence was found for TGD/nonbinary or orientation-specific groups in this pass.
No hardened direct intersex AI-dependence analysis was found in this pass.
